8A. No Warranty or Obligation to Proceed

The Confidential Information is provided by each Disclosing Party on an "as is" basis. Neither Party gives any representation or warranty (express or implied) as to the accuracy, completeness, or fitness for purpose of any Confidential Information disclosed under this Agreement. Neither Party shall have any liability to the other Party for any loss or damage arising from the other Party's use of or reliance on any Confidential Information, save in respect of fraudulent misrepresentation or as expressly set out in this Agreement. Nothing in this Agreement shall oblige either Party to proceed with any transaction, engagement, commercial collaboration, or other arrangement with the other Party.
